_comment: 8d Phase B canonical (8d C1, issue #14, extended in place): teleport-based walkthrough of the two new dungeon maps (dungeon_approach, trapped_halls) -- neither is reachable from any EXISTING live map without the quest state C1 landed (B3's gallery door_when gates on `horns_delve_started`, absent from this fixture), so this script stays the sole proof they render/work independent of the quest, matching street_peek/floodplains_peek's own teleport-only precedent, a real CANONICAL (assert-verified). Loads cisterns_scout_start (warrior L1 + [Tactician]/[Appraise Foe] already known) via title Continue, then teleports in. dungeon_approach now carries 6 entities (the original 3 plus Ceria/Yvlon/Ksmvr, C1's own dungeon_approach NPC trio -- untouched by this route, which never approaches row 5). trapped_halls carried 8 at C1 (the original 6 plus `ksmvr_plates`/`seal_kept_door`, both off this route's own cells; 9 since the #91 shift disclosed below). All 4 trap classes probed as before, with C1's real gates now live and correctly UNMET at this fixture's own state: dart_slit_a's skill-known nudge still fires, but the hotbar disarm now refuses via the NEW `requires_item: trap_kit` gate (this fixture carries no trap_kit -- `delve_skill` is where the real consume lives); snare_nest_slot and vault_boss_slot are now REAL `kind:encounter` entities gated by `encounter_when` (`horns_delve_started`/`halls_cleared` respectively, both unmet here) -- their plain interacts now read the gate-closed fallback (`gate_closed_toast`, copy held verbatim from each entity's own pre-promotion flavor line) instead of banking a flavor accomplishment. Whole-run negative: combat_started never fires (every gate stays unmet at this fixture's own state). ISSUE #91 (hour-4 spine) SHIFT, DISCLOSED: trapped_halls gained a 9th entity, `gallery_vermin_nest` (12,11) -- off every cell this route's own walked path touches (rows 5-9 only, traced against the exact move sequence below), so the walk itself is byte-identical; only the ui_entities_rendered sprite-count assertion below moved 9->10 (entity count + the PC's own sprite). #398-P3 SHIFT, DISCLOSED: trapped_halls gained a warded side-vault pocket in y10-13 x0-9, entirely off this route's rows 5-9 -- three of its five new entities are present at this fixture's zero-progress state (`warded_side_vault_snare_tell`, `warded_side_vault_pry_plate`, and the `warded_side_vault_construct` encounter, which stands visible and inert because present_when is validator-forbidden on encounters), while `warded_side_vault_snare_release` (requires warded_vault_snare_found) and `warded_side_vault_cache` (requires warded_side_vault_secured) are correctly absent. Both pins below moved; the walk itself is byte-identical.

steps._comment: == ENTER dungeon_approach via teleport (unreachable any other way this phase) ==

v019-L2 RE-PIN 6 -> 8: GH#380 seeded the (4,9)/(5,9) rubble spill (`unsteady`, which joins `blocked` at load). Off the perimeter the lap below walks and off all three teleport legs, so the route is byte-identical.

GH#334 note 20 RE-PIN 8 -> 9: dungeon_approach gained `dungeon_wardstone` (2,5), the map's portal carrier. It is UNCONDITIONAL (only its portal_menu_when is gated), so it renders in every state including this fixture's, which never banks dungeon_attuned -- the picker stays shut and the prop answers with its plain toast. Off this route's own walked cells: the bounds lap runs the perimeter and the seal-anchor leg stands at (2,6) facing west.
== bounds lap: the full perimeter is clear (no obstacle sits on the border) -- right 15, down 11, left 15, up 11 returns to (0,0) with zero blocked bumps.
== the gallery-seal anchor (1,6) -- the B3 landing cell, currently an inert rubble-choked flavor prop.

payload_contains.text: The stone doesn't budge. Whatever's on the other side stays sealed. For now.

steps._comment: == the dormant guardian foreshadow (8,9) -- the ratified boss pick's vault_construct sprite, dimmed and still.

payload_contains.text: You keep your distance. A shallow arc is scored into the floor in front of it, ending under one folded knee.

steps._comment: == the REAL new door: dungeon_approach -> trapped_halls (a brand-new pairing between these two brand-new maps, NOT the excluded gallery-door edit).

#398-P3 RE-PIN 12 -> 21, DERIVED not fitted: the side-vault seal adds nine wall cells, one of which -- (9,10) -- was already walled by the pre-existing (9,10)-(9,11) segment. (0,10),(1,10),(3,10),(4,10),(5,10),(6,10),(8,10) close the y10 threshold row; (9,12),(9,13) close the pocket's east side (review B1: without those two, x10 y12/13 walked straight in and (5,12)/(4,13) were reachable with no kit at all). 12 + 7 + 2 = 21. floor_cells stays 280 because floor_layers covers `all` and walls do not subtract floor.

#398-P3 RE-PIN 17 -> 20, DERIVED from this run's own ui_entities_rendered stream (H4: deleting this assertion was unauthorized; the honest fix is a re-pin, not a hole). Three of the five side-vault entities are present at this fixture's zero-progress state: `warded_side_vault_snare_tell` (absent-gated on warded_vault_snare_found + warded_side_vault_open, neither banked), `warded_side_vault_pry_plate` (absent-gated on warded_side_vault_open, not banked), and `warded_side_vault_construct` -- an encounter, so present_when is validator-forbidden and it stands visible and inert exactly as seal_warden_alcove does. `warded_side_vault_snare_release` and `warded_side_vault_cache` are requires-gated and correctly absent. 17 + 3 = 20.
== TRAP CLASS 1: pressure plate (6,7) -- [Appraise Foe] now gives its scoped scenery ambient and banks nothing; a plain interact still TRIGGERS. [Find Trap]'s real read is unit-pinned.

payload_contains.text: [Appraise Foe] — Nothing here is going to fight you.
The flagstone drops half an inch under your palm. A catch clicks somewhere back inside the wall, and nothing comes of it.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 2: dart slit (10,5) -- disarm-only shape. A plain interact with the skill KNOWN reads the 2026-07-10 nudge (never auto-disarms). 8d C1 (issue #14): the hotbar disarm now ALSO gates on carrying `trap_kit` (this fixture carries none -- `delve_skill` proves the real consume) -- the field hotbar attempt refuses via the item_hint_toast, never reaching skill_used/the accomplishment bank.

payload_contains.text: A narrow slit at knee height, the length of the wall; look properly first and there is a mechanism behind it to find.
A narrow slit at knee height, the mechanism seated behind the stone. Bare fingers will not reach the catch; this one takes a trap kit.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 3: illusory floor (14,7) -- 'floor that isn't', zero new sim (entity occupancy alone blocks movement). A literal walk-into-it proves the bump, then the same nudge-then-hotbar-reveal sequence.

payload_contains.text: The floor ahead looks exactly like the floor behind you. An eye trained to look properly would find the difference.
[Appraise Foe] — The false floor turns this passage into a kill lane. The safe line hugs the wall where an ambusher would stand.

steps._comment: == TRAP CLASS 4: snare (17,8) -- PROMOTED to a live encounter (8d C1), `encounter_when` gated on `horns_delve_started` (unmet here). A plain interact now reads the gate-closed fallback -- no accomplishment banked (the old flavor id `spotted_the_snare_nest` retired with the kind swap), just `gate_closed_toast` (copy held verbatim from the pre-promotion flavor line).

payload_contains.text: You step wide around the wire. The dust past it is trodden into a track running both ways; leave the passage until the delve is under way.

steps._comment: == THE VAULT (18,6) -- 8d C1: PROMOTED to a live encounter, `encounter_when` gated on `halls_cleared` AND `horns_party_formed` (both unmet here -- the party leg is the solo-lockout, so a party-less interact can never field the fight). Detours around snare_nest_slot's own occupied cell (17,8) via row 6, then returns to the (16,8) waypoint the pre-existing exit sequence below already expects. Gate-closed fallback: no accomplishment banked (the old flavor id `found_the_vault` retired with the kind swap), just `gate_closed_toast` (the halls+Horns signpost line).

payload_contains.text: The halls are still armed, and the Horns are not with you. Both have to change before you go through this arch.

steps._comment: == EXIT via the real return door (1,7), landing back at dungeon_approach (13,6) -- one cell west of the outbound door's own (14,6) cell.
Scope guard: none of the three dormant slots (dormant_guardian_marker/snare_nest_slot/vault_boss_slot) carries a LIVE combat trigger yet -- whole-run negative proof, C1's own job to arm the gate.
